title: Mrs. Nadejda Alexeyevna Magnusson - Communications From

G. 5000-9-38

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / File No. ...STRY / No. S. B. D. 8884 / Date December 1st. 1938）

Subject Communication dated 21-11-38 from the Netherlands Consulate General
concerning Mrs N.A.Magnusson.
Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by C. Crawford. D. I.

Mrs Nadejda Alexeyevna MAGNUSSON nee Smoliansky,
Russian, born on August 23,1903 at Sretensk, Transbaikal Pro-
vince, Siberia. According to her own statement, she left Rus-
sia for Manchuria in 1918 and for the following three years
attended a Russian school in Harbin, after which she continued
her education at St. Francis School in Chefoo ( 1921-1922).
Following her father's death in 1923 she returned to Harbin to
her mother. In 1929 she married one Mr.L.A. Magnusson, Russian
of German origin. The couple separated in 1930, but apparently
they have not been formally divorced.

Mrs Magnusson is reported to have first arrived in
Shanghai in December,1933 and to have resided for a period at
220 Route Vallon together with her sister,Mrs O.A. Lieverts nee
Smoliansky, after which she left for Tsingtao. Returning here
some time during the autumn of 1934 she stayed with her sister
until 1935 when she proceeded to Harbin. In March,1936 she re-
turned to Shanghai and resided with Mrs Lieverts at 698 Rue
Bourgeat. In April,1938 Mrs Lieverts is reported to have left
for Batavia. Mrs Magnusson spent the summer in Tsingtao return-
ing in Shanghai in October. Her present address is 2 Route De-
lastre.

While in Shanghai she is not known to have any fixed
employment. She is registered with the Russian Emigrants' Com-
mittee, Moulmein Road, and with the B.C.G. Police Bureau ( Reg.
No.11695 ).

Nothing detrimental is known in this office regarding
this person.

（手写签名：A. Prokopiev）
D. S. I.

（左侧边缘手写批注：2/12）
D. C. ( Special Branch)
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特科第一股
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 档案号 ...STRY / 编号 S. B. D. 8884 / 日期 1938年12月1日）

事由：荷兰总领事馆于1938年11月21日来函，涉及 N.A. Magnusson 夫人。
由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）呈报，经督察长 C. Crawford 转呈。

娜杰日达·阿列克谢耶芙娜·马格努松（Nadejda Alexeyevna MAGNUSSON），婚前姓斯莫利扬斯基（Smoliansky），
俄罗斯人，1903年8月23日出生于西伯利亚外贝加尔省斯特列滕斯克（Sretensk）。据其自述，她于1918年离开俄国前往满洲，并在随后的三年里就读于哈尔滨的一所俄罗斯学校，之后在烟台的圣方济各学校（St. Francis School）继续求学（1921-1922年）。1923年父亲去世后，她回到哈尔滨母亲身边。1929年，她嫁给了一位德裔俄国人 L.A. 马格努松（L.A. Magnusson）先生。夫妇二人于1930年分居，但显然并未正式离婚。

据报，马格努松夫人于1933年12月首次抵达上海，曾与其妹 O.A. 利弗茨（Lieverts）夫人（婚前姓斯莫利扬斯基）一同在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）220号居住一段时间，随后前往青岛。1934年秋季某时返回上海后，她与妹妹同住至1935年，之后前往哈尔滨。1936年3月，她回到上海，与利弗茨夫人一同居住在勃艮第路（Rue Bourgeat）698号。据报，利弗茨夫人于1938年4月前往巴达维亚。马格努松夫人在青岛度过夏季，于10月返回上海。她目前的住址是德拉司脱路（Route Delastre）2号。

在上海期间，未发现她有固定职业。她在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会以及白俄警察登记处（B.C.G. Police Bureau）进行了登记（登记号 11695）。

本处未掌握有关此人的任何不利记录。

（手写签名：A. Prokopiev）
特别调查员

（左侧边缘手写批注：2/12）
副督察长（特科）
呈副督察长（特科）助理

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 5333.
SHANGHAI,
11 November 1938.
（印：REGISTRY B. D. 8884）

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mrs. Nadejda Alexeevna MAGNUSSON has applied to this Consulate General for a visa for admission into the Netherlands Indies.

Mrs. Magnusson is in possession of a Ta Tao passport No.00481 issued at Shanghai on June 11, 1938 valid for one year.

According to this document she is born at Sretensk on August 23rd, 1903 and a typist by profession.

She intends to remain in Batavia for approximately three months at the house of her sister Mrs. Olga Alexivna Smoliensky, who acquired the Netherlands nationality through her marriage to Mr. Lieverts, from whom she was divorced however in the course of this year. Mrs. Smoliansky, who has been residing in Shanghai during the last four years, is favourably known to this Consulate-General.

Mrs. Magnusson stated to be registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road, whereas her residence is at 2 Route Delastre.

I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know, if possible, whether anything is known against this person, from a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
（签名）
acting Consul-General.

To the Deputy Commissioner
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

D.S.D. Parkyn
8/11
（签名）
P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA

编号 5333。
上海，
1938年11月11日。
（印：登记处 B. D. 8884）

先生：

谨通知阁下，娜杰日达·阿列克谢耶芙娜·马格努松（Nadejda Alexeevna MAGNUSSON）夫人已向本总领事馆申请进入荷属东印度的签证。

马格努松夫人持有1938年6月11日在上海签发的道台护照（Ta Tao passport）第00481号，有效期一年。

根据该文件，她于1903年8月23日出生于斯特列滕斯克（Sretensk），职业为打字员。

她计划在巴达维亚其姐奥尔加·阿列克谢耶芙娜·斯莫利扬斯基（Olga Alexivna Smoliensky）夫人家中停留约三个月。斯莫利扬斯基夫人因与利弗茨（Lieverts）先生结婚而取得荷兰国籍，但两人已于今年内离婚。斯莫利扬斯基夫人在过去四年间居住于上海，本总领事馆对其评价良好。

马格努松夫人称已在慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）的俄国侨民委员会登记，其居住地址为德拉司脱路（Route Delastre）2号。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否掌握对此人不利的情况，本人将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
代理总领事。

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特科副督察长
上海。

D.S.D. Parkyn
11月8日
（签名）
呈副督察长（特科）助理

page_data.en:
December 2 38.

Acting Consul-General,
Netherlands Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge
receipt of your letter No. 3333 dated November
21, 1938, and in reply to inform you that there
is nothing in Municipal Police records against
Mrs. N. A. Magnusson. A copy of report is attached.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Deputy Commissioner
(Special Branch)
page_data.zh:
1938年12月2日。

代理总领事，
荷兰总领事馆，
上海。

先生：

谨确认收到阁下1938年11月21日第3333号来函，并回复告知，市政警务处档案中并无针对 N. A. 马格努松夫人的不利记录。随函附上报告副本。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副督察长
（特科）

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.
No.3463.

SHANGHAI, 21st December 1938.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. D. 8884 No S. D. 8884）

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter of even date, No.D. 884, concerning Mrs. E. A.
Magnuson, and to thank you for the information contained
therein.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul-General.

To the Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch, Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

谨确认收到阁下同日发出的关于 E. A. 马格努松（Magnuson）夫人的第 D. 884 号信函，并对其中所含信息表示感谢。

总领事。

上海。
